claude-initialize.recorded.jsonl.projection: Only response subtype/request_id and response fields claude_code_version,current_permission_mode,session_state,capabilities retained. Other fields include account and local paths and were omitted.

codex-initialize.recorded.jsonl.projection: Only id and result platformFamily/platformOs retained; userAgent and codexHome omitted to remove host identity/paths.

codex-contract.recorded.json.projection: Required field lists and property names for adapter-used request/notification methods, projected from generated method unions.

cursor-create-chat.recorded.txt.projection: The returned chat UUID is retained; no prompt, model request or tool run occurred.

acp-opencode-initialize.recorded.jsonl.projection: Only jsonrpc/id/result protocolVersion, agentCapabilities and agentInfo retained; auth method descriptions omitted.

acp-hermes-initialize.recorded.jsonl.projection: Only jsonrpc/id/result protocolVersion, agentCapabilities and agentInfo retained; auth method descriptions omitted.

acp-opencode-session-new.recorded.jsonl.projection: Only sessionId retained; configOptions/models omitted because they reflect account state.

pi-handshake.recorded.jsonl.projection: Only id/type/command/success and data sessionId,isStreaming,model.id retained; system prompt and account settings omitted.

omp-handshake.recorded.jsonl.projection: ready frame reduced to protocol facts; get_state response reduced to sessionId,isStreaming,model.id. Notices and command catalogs omitted.

notes: SDK stdio permission control is used instead of an MCP approval server; both route human decisions without auto-approval. Synthetic turns test protocol normalization, not live model responses. M5 fixtures were recorded from the installed CLIs above with initialize/get_state/create-chat only; no prompt or model request was sent. Synthetic turns exercise normalization, permission denial and malformed/oversized handling.
